muted.description: Supporting copy, versions, filters, and metadata.

accent.description: Interactive links, active states, focus, and metadata keys.

accent-secondary.description: Secondary gradient stop and ambient hero treatment.

body.purpose: Localized summaries and general reading text.

breakpoints.name: card-minimum
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum task-card width in the responsive grid.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action with the blue-to-violet gradient; hero actions and direct data/workflow entry points.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.7rem 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; font: 600 1rem/1 var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--color-accent, #6d8bff), var(--color-accent-2, #8b5cf6)); transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #6d8bff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary, bordered button for source navigation; transparent at rest, foreground text on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.7rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 0.75rem; font: 600 1rem/1 var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.32); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #6d8bff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Pill filter control; muted at rest, blue translucent fill with stronger blue border when active. State must not rely on color alone.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, #9aa3b2); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; transition: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #6d8bff); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-chip--active { background: rgba(109,139,255,0.16); color: var(--color-accent, #6d8bff); border-color: rgba(109,139,255,0.4); }

components.name: Tag Pill
components.description: Compact metadata tag inside task cards; small blue translucent pill supporting fast scanning.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(109,139,255,0.12); color: var(--color-accent, #6d8bff); }

components.name: Task Card
components.description: Frosted translucent result card with border-led separation; border shifts toward blue and the card lifts 2px on hover.
components.css: .ds-task-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 1rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-task-card:hover { border-color: rgba(109,139,255,0.5); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-task-card:focus-within { border-color: rgba(109,139,255,0.5); } .ds-task-card__title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); } .ds-task-card__version { align-self: flex-start; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--color-muted, #9aa3b2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Flexible frosted search input with a Soft Divider border and the visible 2px blue focus outline.
components.html: <input type="search" class="ds-search" placeholder="Search tasks..." aria-label="Search tasks" />
components.css: .ds-search { flex: 1 1 220px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #9aa3b2); } .ds-search:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #6d8bff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Locale Toggle
components.description: Grouped bordered language switch (EN / 中文); muted at rest, foreground text on hover/focus. Must preserve EN/ZH structural parity.
components.css: .ds-locale { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-locale__btn { background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, #9aa3b2); border: none; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-locale__btn:hover, .ds-locale__btn:focus-visible { color: var(--color-fg, #e6e8ee); } .ds-locale__btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #6d8bff); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: A focused dark catalog for reusable HagiCode workflows. A nearly black foundation and subdued card surfaces keep task metadata easy to scan, while Workflow Blue identifies the small set of active and actionable states.
keyCharacteristics: Cool blue and violet reserved for hero and primary actions.
Subtle translucent cards separated by borders instead of shadows.
Compact compatibility metadata and tag treatment.
Bilingual English and Simplified Chinese content with shared structure.

rules.name: The Accent-Is-Action Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actionable, active, or focused states; a blue accent without a state or action is visual noise.

rules.name: The Surface-Stays-Quiet Rule
rules.body: Cards use subtle white transparency and borders rather than opaque gray panels, gradients, or stacked shadows.

rules.name: The Locale-Parity Rule
rules.body: Every visible English label that participates in content hierarchy has an equivalent Chinese label in the same component structure.

rules.name: The Hover-Moves-a-Little Rule
rules.body: Interactive task cards may lift by 2px over 150ms; controls communicate state through color, border, or underline before motion.

rules.name: The Focus-Is-Visible Rule
rules.body: Search fields use a 2px Workflow Blue outline with 1px offset. New interactive components must provide an equally visible keyboard focus treatment.

dos: Keep content inside the 1080px page width and preserve the hero-to-toolbar-to-grid reading order.
Use #6D8BFF for focus, active filters, primary actions, and interactive text.
Preserve bilingual content pairs using the existing locale visibility classes.
Provide a visible focus style and explicit empty state for filterable collections.
donts: Do not replace Console Black (#0B0D12) with bright white or mid-gray page surfaces.
Do not spread blue or violet gradients across cards, metadata, or body-copy areas.
Do not add persistent shadows, glassmorphism blur, glowing particles, or neon AI-tool styling.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate selected filters, focus state, or locale.
Do not introduce components that break English and Simplified Chinese structural parity.
